reading.body:
TulsaConnect Downtown Tulsa (DC-5) is a facility in downtown Tulsa, Oklahoma with no published IT capacity or power specifications available. The facility research resolves this row to one named downtown site after its separately confirmed East Tulsa sibling was identified elsewhere, though a second nearby generic row in this registry suggests the operator may describe this as a single building with adjacent entries or duplicate mapping.

Oklahoma has nine mapped data center facilities statewide and zero published megawatt figures from any operator. TulsaConnect is the only facility in the state with any published capacity data in this registry, which means its blank specifications represent the current limit of public disclosure about AI-ready infrastructure in the state. Without published power or IT load figures, the scale of this facility relative to AI training workloads cannot be determined.

No certifications, power capacity, or tenant information is published for this site. The facility's relevance to AI scaling cannot be assessed from available data.
